question.text: Which of the following is EXEMPT from filing its PPM through a Merchant Banker for launch of new schemes?

answer.text: Large Value Fund schemes for accredited investors
Fund of Funds investing in Cat III AIFs

explanation.text: **The Logic:** LVF schemes launch under an 'intimation to SEBI' model, supported by a CEO/Compliance Officer undertaking; the Merchant Banker route does NOT apply to them. **The Trap:** All other Cat III schemes MUST file via a Merchant Banker. Open-ended and FoF structures do not enjoy this exemption. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same LVF carve-out exists in XIX-A (Cat I/II) — the exemption is structure-agnostic. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** When onboarding accredited investors into a LVF, confirm that the PPM carries the signed CEO & CO undertaking in the SEBI-prescribed format.
